prayerExcerpt.en-US: Genevieve was only a poor peasant girl, but Christ dwelt in her heart.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Genoveva era apenas uma pobre camponesa, mas Cristo habitava em seu coração.

meta.face: A young woman of about twenty with a fair, fresh complexion and a BROAD, SQUARE-JAWED face, wide at the cheekbones and firm at the jaw — a smooth, low forehead, a short, straight nose, wide-set clear grey-green eyes under straight, fair brows, a wide, calm, closed mouth, a firm, rounded chin; flaxen-blond hair in two thick braids falling from under the veil; her eyes lowered to the candle flame.
meta.basis: No likeness survives. The book's engraving shows her as the little shepherdess met by St. Germanus, and Wikipedia records the two common attributes: the candle she relit (the devil-and-angel legend) and the shepherdess of the later tradition. The broad, square-jawed peasant face is our choice, to keep her apart from the set's oval-faced virgins (`agnes`, `agatha`, `catherine_alexandria`).
